t: Umar lying on the ground at al-Abtah
a: اللَّهُمَّ كَبِرَتْ سِنِّي وَضَعُفَتْ قُوَّتِي وَانْتَشَرَتْ رَعِيَّتِي . فَاقْبِضْنِي إِلَيْكَ غَيْرَ مُضَيِّعٍ وَلاَ مُفَرِّطٍ
p: Allāhumma kabirat sinnī wa ḍaʿufat quwwatī wa-ntasharat raʿiyyatī. Fa-qbiḍnī ilayka ghayra muḍayyiʿin wa lā mufarriṭ
m: O Allah, my age has grown, my strength has weakened, and the people in my charge have spread far. So take me to Yourself without my having wasted anything or fallen short.
